programme.desc: This sequel captures how singer Tang Qi searches through battle-scarred China for her soldier lover, Xing Ya. However, are they fated to be apart?

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: In veteran writer/ director Yueh Feng's most memorable martial arts movies, the luminous and lethal Shih Szu plays the title swordswoman.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: Two students fall in love but their two families are enemies and separated by a river that is filled with crocodiles and beasts.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by 'Drunken Master', this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist who creates a cricket-style fighting technique to defeat the pugilists who bested him before.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The Mad Monk rushes around saving hawkers from crumbling walls and bullies, recovering stolen money and punishing a ruthless court official and his son.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The 'iron triangle' comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: This compelling Shaw Brothers Huangmei Opera depicts the romance of star-crossed lovers the son of a respected government official and a famed prostitute.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: A brother and sister use the mythical yin/yang Holy Flame kung-fu technique when they seek vengeance for their dead parents.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Follow a virtuous viper as it sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a dangerous lady in this thriller!

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this sequel, the Mad Monk is joined by immortal scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin, as they both wreak havoc in an attempt to outdo each other!

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Michelle Mei Suet plays Szu-szu, a spoiled girl who leaves her beau Yang Fan, to go off in search of a swordsman whom she idolizes. Whom will she end up with?

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Take a vacation with sexy Lily Ho and Jimmy Lin Chong on a whirlwind tour of Southeast Asia in one of Shaw Brothers most lively 1960's musical romances.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: Veteran Yueh Feng made this 'Martial Arts World' saga of a masked master of the 'Black Sand Hand Technique,' starring Lily Ho in a dual role.

programme.title: Let's Fall in Love
programme.desc: Pressured by his parents to marry prior to taking over his father's business, Guan rejects every girl they find but then, he stumbles upon the perfect one?

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of female warriors and a group of ruthless bandits who teams up to raid the emperor's tomb. Will they be successful?

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: The Shaw Brothers' directors created this 60's classic depicting a timeless romance between a wealthy man and a songbird.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: First a hero and then his daughter try to protect Ming Emperor Jianwen infant son from rebels headed by Tien Fung.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: A cruel uncle stands in the way between a young scholar and the beautiful gal with whom he falls in love, and happiness.

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The first make HK$1 million at the local box office, Chang Cheh's Wuxia film sparked a new age in martial arts films with its male anti-heroes and violence.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess.

programme.title: Return of the Dead
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang's dark offering depicts the destructive effects of lust as narrated by three psychiatric patients in an asylum.

programme.title: Song of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei exchanges her martial arts weaponry for a syringe in this exotic contemporary drama by Pan Lei.

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss
programme.desc: A martial arts sifu and a hip marketing wiz have to overlook their differences to outsmart gangsters who are trying to take them down.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu, who is trying to shed his criminal side, instead finds himself caught up in an all-out gang war that comes to a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth
programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hu's first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: A wine shop owner's son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge?

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Wong Yue and Gordon Liu star in this entertaining 'hopping vampire' action comedy.

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are saved by Master Lian during a botched exorcism and they beseech him to teach them. Then his friend is killed and with his master's help, Lu avenges him.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: A traitorous clansman bids to locate and then unleash the deadly 'Five Venom Spider' against those who bid to stand in his way.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Starring Kara Hui, Yuen Tak and Meng Yuen Man, this film depicts a series of battles as everyone fights over the 'Yuan Yang Swords', which hold the secrets to Kung Fu.

programme.title: Come Drink With Me
programme.desc: King Hu's groundbreaking film set the foundation for all his action films that followed, most notably Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon.

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Problems ensue after one of two childhood friends who have vowed to become sisters through the exchange of bracelets gets married.

programme.title: The Hidden Power of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: When defeated villain, Sung Ching-shu, restarts his reign of terror after mastering the yin and yang combination, only two swordsmen can stop him.

programme.title: Moods of Love
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Two master jewel thieves are set on the same target, but sparks fly between them when they first meet and they fall instantly in love, not knowing that they are rivals.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: A clash of cultures and such ensue after Mr. Funny Bone and Big Potato open an old-fashioned healing clinic in ultra-modern Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: In this saga of two warring clans, Tsao Feng from the Flag of Iron betrays Lo, his master and teams up with the enemy. Unexpectedly, Lo returns for revenge.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: In Shaw Brothers' showcase for the talented Ling Yun, a young drummer hungry for fame sacrifices everything including love, for his art. Will the prize prove worth the cost?

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Award-winning actor Ku Feng plays the cunning pirate Lei Chen-tien, flanked by Wan Ping who disguises herself as a boy to beat him to the treasure.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: A woman gets involved in a Ching Dynasty salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and dilemmas gone rotten.

programme.title: Shadow Girl

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu Lan

programme.desc: Detonation of an explosive device causes terror in the flight and pilot Gyu-Sik loses sight in one eye. Yong-dae who hatched the hijacking plot, threatens to take the plane to North Korea.

programme.title: Kingmaker
programme.desc: A politician met a talented campaign strategist who helped him in becoming the strongest presidential election candidate. Yet conflicts deepen as the he disagrees with the latter on his ideologies.

programme.title: The Book of Fish
programme.desc: Joseon scholar Chung Yak-jeon was exiled during the 1801 Catholic Persecution. He met a fisherman and decided to exchange knowledge with him in writing the book of fish.

programme.title: The Goblin
programme.desc: After ten years in jail, Doohyun is released and wants nothing more than to live an ordinary life, but when his old partner kidnaps his daughter, the long-hidden Goblin inside him awakes.

programme.title: Single in Seoul
programme.desc: Yeong-Ho is a famous influencer who praises living a single life. Hyeon-Jin is an editor who is desperate about finding her partner. The two meets while working together for a book.

programme.title: Devils
programme.desc: Jae-hwan is a detective catching the serial murderer Jin-hyeok and they have a physical struggle. When Jae-hwan wakes up in the hospital, he realized their bodies have been switched...

programme.title: Decision to Leave
programme.desc: When detective Hae-Joon investigates the death of a man who fell from a mountaintop and meets his wife Seo-rae, he starts to suspect her at the same time that he begins feeling an attraction to her.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: After barely surviving a violent attack by an elusive serial killer, a crime boss finds himself forming an unlikely partnership with a local detective to catch the sadistic killer.

programme.title: Holy Night: Demon Hunters
programme.desc: A city descends into chaos, plagued by a demon and his followers. Holy Night, a special team steps in to bring justice to the forces of evil. Will they be able to save the world?

programme.title: Matcha & Ogura Toast
programme.desc: Outside Kyoto, Emmy learns the intricacies and traditions of making matcha, and visits a 600-year-old tea farm. Later, Emmy takes in the cafe culture of Nagoya through Ogura toast and a handful of local specialties.

programme.title: Shichimi 7 Spice Blend & Rum Raisin
programme.desc: In Nagano, Emmy heads to a shichimi pepper farm and a 300-year-old spice shop to learn the history of the 7 spice blend. Later, Emmy tries Tokyo's popular treats to find out how rum raisin gained such prominence in the area.

programme.title: Meet the Parents
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is making Steakhouse classics for his main meal; for his solo meal he’s putting his own twist on a traditional eggs benedict. His mystery meal will of course be a surprise but will hopefully win over even the pickiest parentals.

programme.title: Jerkin' and GRILLIN'
programme.desc: Back from a trip to Negril, Jamaica, chef Derrell Smith brings his favorite dishes back to his own yard! Grillin’ up Jerk Chicken, Saltfish and Ackee, coconut peas and rice and other Caribbean favorites for his two friends.

programme.title: A Cruciferous Delicious Time
programme.desc: No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they’ve become a fixture in Frankie’s meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time.

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Mayo: The Secret Ingredient
programme.desc: Who knew mayo could be such a savvy secret agent? It’s a controversial condiment that can unlock the buttery, crispy, decadent codes of our favorite dishes, without leaving a trace of mayo-ness. Best of all, it’s easy to make at home!

programme.title: Summer BBQ
programme.desc: Summer is coming to a close but there’s still a bounty of fresh, seasonal produce to enjoy. Celebrate with Frankie as he makes some of his favorite cookout classics that’ll take you from a weekend picnic to a backyard BBQ, with or without a grill.

programme.title: Salad Salad Salad
programme.desc: Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

programme.title: Killer Carbonara & Seasoned Salad
programme.desc: Who says a weeknight meal can’t be decadent, delicious, and easy to make? Chef Jason Neroni is taking flavors up and over the edge in his homage to his Italian roots with a few of his favorites: Chopped Salad and Smoked Carbonara Tagliatelle.

programme.title: Mexican-Inspired Family Favorites
programme.desc: As a mother of four boys, Chef Christy Vega has mastered how to please everyone at the table. In this episode, she is whipping up a crowd-pleasing menu both kids and adults will love including guacamole, quesadillas, fish, and a sweet treat!

programme.title: Crispy & Creamy Cali-Soul Food
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Keith Corbin is sharing his personal journey through food with his show-stopping, Cali-Soul menu: Black-Eyed Pea Fritters, Cream of Mushroom Mac & Cheese, and his secret technique to making fried chicken with crispy skin.

programme.title: Grilled Pork with Corn & Greens
programme.desc: Chef Jamie Lauren is showing us how to take your grilling game up to the next level. One element is more delicious than the next. On the menu: her Marinated & Grilled Pork Tenderloin topped with Hazelnut Salsa Macha, Corn Puree, Quick Braised Greens.

programme.title: Enveloped in Sole, Sauce, & Caesar Salad
programme.desc: Chef Shirley Chung combines her experiences of cooking in renowned French and Italian restaurants with her Chinese heritage, to create a one-of-a-kind, out-of-this-world menu with a salad, a fish, and a panna cotta.

programme.title: Sweet & Sour Steak Dinner
programme.desc: Steak and potatoes are surely a staple, but in this episode, we get to see how a Chef does this classic pairing. Chef Jason Neroni is showing us how to make his Sweet and Sour Steak and Togarashi Potatoes along with a Marinated Cucumber Salad.

programme.title: Crispy & Creamy Cali-Soul Food
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Keith Corbin is sharing his personal journey through food with his show-stopping, Cali-Soul menu: Black-Eyed Pea Fritters, Cream of Mushroom Mac & Cheese, and his secret technique to making fried chicken with crispy skin.

programme.title: Grilled Pork with Corn & Greens
programme.desc: Chef Jamie Lauren is showing us how to take your grilling game up to the next level. One element is more delicious than the next. On the menu: her Marinated & Grilled Pork Tenderloin topped with Hazelnut Salsa Macha, Corn Puree, Quick Braised Greens.

programme.title: Enveloped in Sole, Sauce, & Caesar Salad
programme.desc: Chef Shirley Chung combines her experiences of cooking in renowned French and Italian restaurants with her Chinese heritage, to create a one-of-a-kind, out-of-this-world menu with a salad, a fish, and a panna cotta.

programme.title: Sweet & Sour Steak Dinner
programme.desc: Steak and potatoes are surely a staple, but in this episode, we get to see how a Chef does this classic pairing. Chef Jason Neroni is showing us how to make his Sweet and Sour Steak and Togarashi Potatoes along with a Marinated Cucumber Salad.

programme.title: Summer BBQ
programme.desc: Summer is coming to a close but there’s still a bounty of fresh, seasonal produce to enjoy. Celebrate with Frankie as he makes some of his favorite cookout classics that’ll take you from a weekend picnic to a backyard BBQ, with or without a grill.

programme.title: Salad Salad Salad
programme.desc: Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

programme.title: Struggle Soup
programme.desc: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie’s soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.title: Cabbage, cabbage, cabbage
programme.desc: Cabbage has long been an underrated green on the field, and it’s about time Frankie gives it a starring role. This leafy head proves itself as the versatile ingredient we need it to be, affordable year around, delicious and filling.

programme.title: Super Soup n' Salads
programme.desc: Which appetizer reigns supreme - soup or salad? Why not have both?! We’ve got chicken caesar salad tacos, French onion soup in a bread bowl, and a creamy curry corn chowder that will warm you right up.

programme.title: Good n' Garlicky
programme.desc: Some say garlic is the gift of the gods...and we say there’s nothing better than the garlicky aroma of bacon & mashed potato garlic knots, garlic butter scallops, or gnocchi with garlic marinara. Who needs breath mints?

programme.title: Wasabi & Strawberry Cheesecake
programme.desc: Tastemaker Emmy Cho travels to Shizuoka and Yokohama to discover the secrets of Kit Kat's Wasabi and Strawberry Cheesecake flavors.

programme.title: Matcha & Ogura Toast
programme.desc: Outside Kyoto, Emmy learns the intricacies and traditions of making matcha, and visits a 600-year-old tea farm. Later, Emmy takes in the cafe culture of Nagoya through Ogura toast and a handful of local specialties.

programme.title: Jerkin' and GRILLIN'
programme.desc: Back from a trip to Negril, Jamaica, chef Derrell Smith brings his favorite dishes back to his own yard! Grillin’ up Jerk Chicken, Saltfish and Ackee, coconut peas and rice and other Caribbean favorites for his two friends.

programme.title: A Cruciferous Delicious Time
programme.desc: No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they’ve become a fixture in Frankie’s meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time.

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Mayo: The Secret Ingredient
programme.desc: Who knew mayo could be such a savvy secret agent? It’s a controversial condiment that can unlock the buttery, crispy, decadent codes of our favorite dishes, without leaving a trace of mayo-ness. Best of all, it’s easy to make at home!

programme.title: The Perfect Pairing
programme.desc: What’s better than your two favorite things coming together for the best bite ever? With pizza waffles, french fry corn dogs, and a pasta frittata, these dynamic duos will not disappoint.

programme.title: Ball it Up
programme.desc: Nothing better than the perfect-sized bite, and these dishes are great all year ‘round.’ Whether it’s cauliflower balls, tomato soup with mozza-balls, or mac n’ cheese balls, we’re rolling them all out for you.

programme.title: The More Cheddar the Better
programme.desc: Erwan creates healthier alternatives to two classic cheesy dishes: Mac N’ Cheese and Grilled Cheese.

programme.title: Finger Foods
programme.desc: Erwan creates healthier alternatives to traditional finger foods: Nachos and Pizza.

programme.title: Cinco de Mayo Tostadas & Tamales
programme.desc: Tonight’s menu is all about the greatest hits. Chef Christy Vega is making Tostada Chiquita, Chicken Tamales with her signature Smoked Blanca Sauce, and her treasured recipe for Albondigas Soup, and she’s pairing it all with their Classic Margarita.

programme.title: Mom’s Favorite Indian-Inspired Dishes

programme.desc: Mia Starr gives a crash course in her all-time favorite, most used decorating techniques. From piping styles to watercolor frosting to maximalist designs, she teaches the basics of holiday cake decorating, in her own signature style.

programme.desc: Join Mia on a trip around the world – without leaving the kitchen! From the Japanese Christmas Cake to Jewish Rugelach to German Pfeffernüsse to Mexican Buñuelos. Your taste buds will get a tour with these holiday bakes from around the world.

programme.desc: Ben Hundreds hits restaurants inspired by heritage, including Cobi’s - where maximalism meets Southeast Asian, the California comfort food of Alta Adams and Yangban Society’s colorful Korean-American deli concept. Plus the best tacos in LA.

programme.desc: Ben Hundreds spins through his hometown of L.A. visiting Chifa, a fashion-infused Peruvian/Chinese restaurant, authentic Mexican at La Casita Mexicana and Motherwolf - Evan Funke’s opulent Roman spot. Plus art galleries, shopping and burgers.

programme.desc: India is known for its diversity of people who have come from far away lands to make it their home. In this episode we meet expats and early settlers of India like the Persians and find out from them what keeps them in India.

programme.title: Music & Indo-Chinese

programme.title: Beauty & Chaats

programme.title: Start-ups & Lunch On The Go

programme.title: Love & Home Food

programme.title: It's Taco Time
programme.desc: Tacos are the way to Chef Dale’s heart, and to prove it, he’s grilling up a sweet and smoky lemongrass and guajillo pork with pineapple, served with coconut and cotija cheese corn and an avocado jicama salad.

programme.title: Restaurant-Style Whole Roast Fish
programme.desc: Grilling isn’t only about fast and casual dinners. Chef Dale grills to impress with this elegant, restaurant quality meal of whole roasted fish, coconut milk grits, and snow pea, watermelon and tamarind salad.

programme.title: The Chicken Episode
programme.desc: If you’re going to grill chicken, you’ll want to make it good. Chef Dale likes to kick up the heat with his angry chicken, a spicy, spatchcocked and grilled whole chicken, and his kung pao chicken wings.

programme.title: Brunch On The Grill
programme.desc: Wake up, it’s time to grill! Chef Dale greets the day with a showstopping dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with creme fraiche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.

programme.title: Vegetables, But Delicious
programme.desc: Grilling is the perfect way to imbue your veggies with deliciousness. Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.

programme.title: Kabobs and Skewers
programme.desc: Kabobs and skewers are a family tradition for Chef Dale. This Mediterranean-inspired meal features beef and shrimp kabobs with grilled tomatoes, potatoes, and eggplant, all served on warm pita with a tangy white sauce.

programme.title: Perfectly Prepared Steaks
programme.desc: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse.

programme.title: Grill These Sandwiches
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: Pearls in Palawan
programme.desc: Erwan travels to the gorgeous island of Palawan where he meets with the locals and learns about pearl farming.

programme.title: Octopus in Isabela
programme.desc: In this episode, Erwan travels to the remote area of Palanan in Isabela, where he meets the Dumagat tribe and learns how to catch an octopus the traditional way.

programme.title: Mud Crab in Dumaguete
programme.desc: Erwan learned how to catch crustaceans while growing up, but in Dumaguete, he discovers their unique regional approach to catching mud crabs.

programme.title: Rainbow Runner in Apo Island
programme.desc: Apo Island is famous for its marine Sanctuary. Erwan meets environmentalists and learns about the Rainbow Runner fish.

programme.title: Fruit Bat in Mindoro
programme.desc: On the island of Mindoro, Erwan samples a traditional Filipino Adobo, made with an unlikely source of protein - locally caught fruit bats.

programme.title: Flying Fish in Batanes
programme.desc: Batanes, known for its breathtaking coastline, is home to the mataw fishermen clan. With their guidance, Erwan sets out to catch dorado by using flying fish as bait.

programme.title: Smoked Pork in Sagada
programme.desc: In the mountainous region of Sagada, Erwan sets out to find out more about a local favorite smoked pork: Etag. Along the way, he meets a French chef, an Etag producer, and a local cook who teaches him about indigenous Igorot dishes.

programme.title: World's Smallest Edible Fish in Bicol
programme.desc: Known as the tiniest edible fish in the world, sinarapan are found in the many lakes covering the Bicol region. We follow Erwan as he attempts to catch these minuscule fish and see the many ways they can be prepared.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Dinner
programme.desc: Thanksgiving dinner will be a breeze this year thanks to Frankie’s struggle tips for a delicious holiday meal. From a simple turkey entree to a new twist on a classic dessert, Frankie makes a feast without unstuffing his wallet.

programme.title: Easy Meals For A Crowd

programme.desc: Start a new tradition at the dinner table this year with a meat free spin on your favorite main courses. Learn new tips and tricks to make your veggie forward dinner so delightful that even the biggest meat eaters will be back for seconds.

programme.desc: This week, treat yourself to a restaurant-worthy pasta dinner at a fraction of the price, as Frankie cooks up some of his signature dishes featuring show stopping sauces.

programme.title: Smoked Pork in Sagada
programme.desc: In the mountainous region of Sagada, Erwan sets out to find out more about a local favorite smoked pork: Etag. Along the way, he meets a French chef, an Etag producer, and a local cook who teaches him about indigenous Igorot dishes.

programme.title: World's Smallest Edible Fish in Bicol
programme.desc: Known as the tiniest edible fish in the world, sinarapan are found in the many lakes covering the Bicol region. We follow Erwan as he attempts to catch these minuscule fish and see the many ways they can be prepared.

programme.title: The Chicken Episode
programme.desc: If you’re going to grill chicken, you’ll want to make it good. Chef Dale likes to kick up the heat with his angry chicken, a spicy, spatchcocked and grilled whole chicken, and his kung pao chicken wings.

programme.title: Brunch On The Grill
programme.desc: Wake up, it’s time to grill! Chef Dale greets the day with a showstopping dutch baby pancake and tangerine syrup, crispy hash browns topped with creme fraiche and roe, and a ham steak smothered in sweet cherry mostarda and red eye gravy.

programme.title: Vegetables, But Delicious
programme.desc: Grilling is the perfect way to imbue your veggies with deliciousness. Chef Dale crafts a family style platter of trumpet mushrooms, eggplant marinated in spicy ssam jang, and charred yellow squash served with a green goddess dressing.

programme.desc: Kabobs and skewers are a family tradition for Chef Dale. This Mediterranean-inspired meal features beef and shrimp kabobs with grilled tomatoes, potatoes, and eggplant, all served on warm pita with a tangy white sauce.

programme.title: Perfectly Prepared Steaks
programme.desc: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse.

programme.title: Grill These Sandwiches
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: Pearls in Palawan
programme.desc: Erwan travels to the gorgeous island of Palawan where he meets with the locals and learns about pearl farming.

programme.title: Octopus in Isabela
programme.desc: In this episode, Erwan travels to the remote area of Palanan in Isabela, where he meets the Dumagat tribe and learns how to catch an octopus the traditional way.

programme.title: Spice Vibes
programme.desc: Chef Nyesha Arrington is taking us on a crazy delicious journey of flavor and texture! Tonight, she’s making Steamed Red Snapper en Banana Leaf, Coconut Cauliflower Rice & Lentils, and for dessert, a decadent, sweet, and moist Kabocha Squash Cake.

programme.title: A Mexican-Inspired Game Day Meal
programme.desc: Mexican cuisine is decidedly the favorite in the Ryan household. And when it comes to feeding a big group, Chef Daisy Ryan has the ultimate menu planned for you. She’s cooking up a meal including Pork, Peanut and Green Chile Stew and Green Rice.

programme.title: Show Me The Mole
programme.desc: Frankie shows you how to make delicious and filling Mexican-inspired dishes for under $2 a plate, and later uses a surprising struggle ingredient in 3 delicious dishes you’ll go nuts for.

programme.title: The Weekly Struggle Budget
programme.desc: Frankie figured out the weekly budget grocery equation so you don’t have to. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner for seven days, for a family of four, for under $150. All it takes is a little planning, meal prep, and using up leftovers in inventive ways.

programme.title: Top These Tacos
programme.desc: Let’s taco-bout how many varieties of tacos truly exist. We don’t have all of them, but we have a ton - poke tuna tacos, socca fish tacos, grilled chicken tacos, and even a mini taco bake! Get out the salsa & guac now!

programme.title: I'm Stuffed

And Aztec the Harris Hawk needs a spot of surgery.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Samoyed dogs, known as "smiling angels" are in fact not easy to raise. They require enough love and dedication, especially extraordinary physical strength!!! For you to be happy and healthy with them.nIf you want to raise a Samoyed, or already own one, we hope you can give them the best care and love, and make them your best partners. Come and jot notes of the hard work and tears shared by expert owners :)!

programme.title: My House And Other Animals

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner". While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you. However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her "experiences in ruling over dozens of cats", which is extremely precious. Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! How can one be the creator of the underwater world? Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

It’s disaster, Code Yellow, as the "storm on steroids" is only just beginning to rend the earth.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E02 - Jean Claude Van Schappert
programme.desc: 特里進入慢動作和爆炸的世界，試圖模仿尚-克勞德在《硬目標》中的表現。特里和拉里將測試《硬目標》電影中的5個場景。其中之一會讓你再也不想透過瞄準孔看了。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E03 - Tickets Please
programme.desc: Las empresas de vuelos espaciales comerciales están cada vez más cerca de estar preparadas para volar. Pronto se lanzarán al espacio clientes de pago; se prevé que los ingresos por turismo sean un importante peldaño hacia la exploración y colonización del espacio.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E04 - Planet X
programme.desc: La misión New Horizons sigue adentrándose en el espacio. Ante la proximidad de su próximo objetivo, algunos especulan con la posibilidad de que haya indicios de la existencia de un nuevo planeta misterioso, largamente envuelto en el folclore. ¿Podría existir el Planeta X?

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E09 - Private Military Contractors
programme.desc: La práctica de contratar ejércitos privados se remonta a la antigüedad, y la mística asociada al guerrero mercenario ha sido objeto de numerosos estudios históricos y caracterizaciones de ficción. Este episodio de CQB examina desde una perspectiva más contemporánea un día en la vida de un grupo de contratistas civiles, y cómo ha evolucionado su papel en el campo de batalla moderno. Gracias a sus técnicas de análisis en "sub-segundos" y a sus imágenes en primera persona, CQB desvela los antecedentes, el entrenamiento y el equipamiento de los "soldados de alquiler" de hoy en día, y cómo los ejércitos privados están cambiando la forma en que se desarrollan los conflictos en todo el mundo.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E10 - Close Protection
programme.desc: Desde los ex miembros de élite de las fuerzas especiales encargados de custodiar a jefes de Estado en zonas de conflicto hasta los equipos de dos personas que protegen a directores ejecutivos en regiones peligrosas, los guardaespaldas de hoy en día deben conocer bien las técnicas de combate cuerpo a cuerpo. Cada operación requiere un enorme trabajo de planificación y preparación. Desde los viajes en avión, los convoyes de coches y las lanzaderas de helicópteros hasta el tráfico básico a pie, un escuadrón de escolta debe estar completamente al tanto del Quién, Qué, Dónde y Cuándo de cualquier situación. Este episodio de CQB se centra en las complejas operaciones cotidianas y minuto a minuto de estos equipos de élite y en las técnicas altamente desarrolladas que emplean.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E09 - Private Military Contractors
programme.desc: La práctica de contratar ejércitos privados se remonta a la antigüedad, y la mística asociada al guerrero mercenario ha sido objeto de numerosos estudios históricos y caracterizaciones de ficción. Este episodio de CQB examina desde una perspectiva más contemporánea un día en la vida de un grupo de contratistas civiles, y cómo ha evolucionado su papel en el campo de batalla moderno. Gracias a sus técnicas de análisis en "sub-segundos" y a sus imágenes en primera persona, CQB desvela los antecedentes, el entrenamiento y el equipamiento de los "soldados de alquiler" de hoy en día, y cómo los ejércitos privados están cambiando la forma en que se desarrollan los conflictos en todo el mundo.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E10 - Close Protection
programme.desc: Desde los ex miembros de élite de las fuerzas especiales encargados de custodiar a jefes de Estado en zonas de conflicto hasta los equipos de dos personas que protegen a directores ejecutivos en regiones peligrosas, los guardaespaldas de hoy en día deben conocer bien las técnicas de combate cuerpo a cuerpo. Cada operación requiere un enorme trabajo de planificación y preparación. Desde los viajes en avión, los convoyes de coches y las lanzaderas de helicópteros hasta el tráfico básico a pie, un escuadrón de escolta debe estar completamente al tanto del Quién, Qué, Dónde y Cuándo de cualquier situación. Este episodio de CQB se centra en las complejas operaciones cotidianas y minuto a minuto de estos equipos de élite y en las técnicas altamente desarrolladas que emplean.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E04 - Brotherly Love
programme.desc: La falta de oportunidades de caza ha agotado la paciencia de Chris y Casey. Las discusiones se suceden cuando no se ponen de acuerdo sobre si quedarse en el mismo lugar o hacer porteo hasta un nuevo lago. Las señales de un oso recuerdan a los hermanos que deben mantener la concentración para seguir con vida.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E05 - Hunger Pains
programme.desc: Los síntomas de inanición se han apoderado de Chris y Casey, que llevan días sin comer. Cuando se cruzan con un urogallo, ocurre lo inesperado. La frustración aumenta a medida que bajan las temperaturas. Los hermanos montan un nuevo campamento, pero ¿ayudará a la caza?

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E06 - White Out
programme.desc: Sin caza mayor a la vista, Chris y Casey se ven obligados a depender de la pesca para alimentarse. Las bajas temperaturas han ralentizado a los peces, creando desafíos. Cuando la madre naturaleza trae una brutal tormenta de nieve, los hermanos se ponen a prueba como nunca antes.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E07 - Motherly Love
programme.desc: Tras semanas intentando sobrevivir en Saskatchewan, Chris y Casey aún no han matado ningún animal de caza mayor. El tiempo se agota a medida que los osos empiezan a hibernar. La fuerza de voluntad mental se agota. Pero un mensaje de vuelta a casa lo cambia todo.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E08 - Refuelled
programme.desc: Un giro en los acontecimientos levanta el ánimo de los hermanos, pero crea un enorme obstáculo que deben superar a medida que se adentran en una nueva carrera contra el reloj.Chris y Casey reflexionan sobre los retos a los que se han enfrentado hasta ahora, y los desafíos que aún tienen por delante.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E03 - Epidemic
programme.desc: Desperate Hours analiza grandes epidemias como el brote africano de ébola en Sudán, que acabó provocando casos en Estados Unidos e Inglaterra, el brote indio de viruela en Bihar, el brote africano de cólera, el brote de SARS en Guanghzhou (China) y la gripe aviar de Hong Kong.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E04 - Wind
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas analiza el poder destructivo del viento. Desde el poder devastador del huracán Katrina en Nueva Orleans hasta el destructor ciclón Nargis en Myanmar, pasando por la tormenta de 1960, el huracán Donna en Florida, el tornado Joplin en Misuri y el huracán Sandy en Nueva York.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E05 - Fire
programme.desc: El terror abrasador de un incendio puede equipararse a cualquier cosa de la creación en lo que a amenaza se refiere. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los incendios, como el del sábado negro en Victoria (Australia), el de la discoteca Station en Rhode Island, el de los grandes almacenes L'Innovation en Bruselas (Bélgica), el de la armería en Lagos (Nigeria) y el de la nueva zona de desarrollo de Binhai en Tianjin (China).

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E06 - Flood
programme.desc: Cuando se rompe el dique, la cosa se pone fea.... Horas desesperadas repasa algunas de las inundaciones más devastadoras de la historia, como la de Río de Janeiro en Brasil, las de Luisiana en Estados Unidos, las de Hamburgo en Alemania, las de Uttarakhand en el norte de la India y el tsunami del Océano Índico en el sudeste asiático.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E07 - Geological Disasters
programme.desc: A veces, todo lo que se necesita es un movimiento bajo los pies.... Horas desesperadas examina las principales catástrofes geológicas, como las avalanchas de Afganistán, Pakistán, Nepal, Perú y Francia. También analiza desprendimientos geológicos en Filipinas, India y Colombia y un enorme socavón que consumió un estanque en Bosnia. También analiza las ventiscas en Estados Unidos, Israel y Reino Unido.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E08 - Tree Stand Fall
programme.desc: El cazador de ciervos Nathan Holcomb cae en picado desde su puesto en el árbol. La peor pesadilla de cualquier cazador se convierte en la realidad de Nathan. Con la espalda rota y paralizado, Nathan debe arrastrarse por su cuenta para encontrar ayuda.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E07 - The Journal
programme.desc: En lo que se considera una de las mayores historias de supervivencia del siglo XX, el marinero Steven Callahan se encuentra solo y a la deriva en una balsa salvavidas después de que su barco, el Napoleon Solo se hunda en pleno Atlántico.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E10 - Adrift Part 2
programme.desc: Enfrentado al hambre, la deshidratación y los depredadores de las profundidades, el marinero Steven Callahan lucha por sobrevivir no sólo a las dificultades físicas, sino también a la tensión mental y emocional de estar a la deriva y solo en una balsa salvavidas que se desintegra.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E01 - Nightmare Canyon Part 1
programme.desc: El descenso de fin de semana de Justin y Jeremy Harris a un remoto cañón de Utah se convierte en una pesadilla de supervivencia cuando Justin se rompe gravemente una pierna. A medida que se acerca la noche y las temperaturas descienden por debajo del punto de congelación, ¿cómo sobrevivirán estos dos hermanos?

programme.desc: Desperate Hours analiza grandes epidemias como el brote africano de ébola en Sudán, que acabó provocando casos en Estados Unidos e Inglaterra, el brote indio de viruela en Bihar, el brote africano de cólera, el brote de SARS en Guanghzhou (China) y la gripe aviar de Hong Kong.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E04 - Wind
programme.desc: Horas desesperadas analiza el poder destructivo del viento. Desde el poder devastador del huracán Katrina en Nueva Orleans hasta el destructor ciclón Nargis en Myanmar, pasando por la tormenta de 1960, el huracán Donna en Florida, el tornado Joplin en Misuri y el huracán Sandy en Nueva York.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E05 - Fire
programme.desc: El terror abrasador de un incendio puede equipararse a cualquier cosa de la creación en lo que a amenaza se refiere. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los incendios, como el del sábado negro en Victoria (Australia), el de la discoteca Station en Rhode Island, el de los grandes almacenes L'Innovation en Bruselas (Bélgica), el de la armería en Lagos (Nigeria) y el de la nueva zona de desarrollo de Binhai en Tianjin (China).

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E01 - Diana A Portrait
programme.desc: 黛安娜，威爾士公主，真是令人著迷，並在她的時代留下了與其他女性不同的印記。作為童話公主、關心丈夫的妻子和時尚開創者，這部紀錄片探索了更深的意義，以揭示在持續的公眾關注背後的真實人。

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R. - S01:E01 - Rhino Wars
programme.desc: Carter's W.A.R. (Wild Animal Response) es la historia jamás contada de la búsqueda de un hombre para salvar su tierra natal, el continente más salvaje y peligroso del mundo, África. Desde cazadores furtivos fuertemente armados que masacran elefantes por sus colmillos hasta la matanza de rinocerontes por sus cuernos, el recurso más preciado de África está en peligro. ¿Puede un hombre descubrir la verdad y cambiar las cosas? Vea cómo Ivan Carter, detective y cazador profesional de animales salvajes, le lleva al interior del África real, al frente de las guerras que se libran contra su fauna salvaje.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E01 - Back In The Brooks
programme.desc: 經過幾年的努力，Keefer兄弟終於回到阿拉斯加的荒野，探索碎石路。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E02 - Maniac Mountain
programme.desc: 十多年之後，狂人山為兄弟們帶來了另一個開創性的成就。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E03 - S-Smart Terry
programme.desc: 給我一些糖，寶貝。特里穿越時間，測試受歡迎的《黑暗軍團》。特里不僅能測試幾個場景，還能與傳奇人物布魯斯·坎貝爾進行面對面的談話。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E04 - Terry's Brave Heart
programme.desc: 特里透過模仿《勇敢的心》中的威廉·華萊士來惹惱拉里。他不僅可以揮舞威廉爵士的劍，還說服拉里為他建造一座投石機。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E05 - Hyabusa
programme.desc: La misión japonesa de retorno de muestras de asteroides ha alcanzado su objetivo y está inspeccionando la roca espacial, lista para sumergirse y adquirir su muestra. El retorno a la Tierra de material procedente de asteroides ayudará a los científicos a desarrollar sistemas de defensa planetaria.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E06 - Fresh Eyes
programme.desc: Dos nuevos telescopios espaciales, Gaia y TESS, están en órbita con sus misiones principales llegando a su fin. A ellos se unirá el telescopio James Webb, y juntos abrirán un nuevo panorama en el tiempo y el espacio.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E11 - Counter Terrorism
programme.desc: Nach den Anschlägen vom 11. September wurde die Militärpräsenz in New York und anderen amerikanischen Städten alltäglich, und den Antiterroreinheiten wurde praktisch ein "Blankoscheck" ausgestellt, wenn es darum ging, sicherzustellen, dass nie wieder ein Terroranschlag auf amerikanischem Boden stattfinden würde. Diese Folge von CQB wirft einen detaillierten Blick darauf, wer für die Besetzung von Elitepositionen in der Terrorismusbekämpfung ausgewählt wurde, wofür sie ausgebildet wurden und wie sie ausgerüstet waren: Wenn die gegnerischen Kräfte Verkehrsflugzeuge und chemische Waffen einsetzen, sind die Gegenmaßnahmen zwangsläufig kompliziert und vielfältig. CQB wirft einen intimen Blick darauf, wie es war, ein Beamter zu sein, der in Washington DC vor chemischen Angriffen gewarnt wurde, oder ein Reservist der Armee, der verdächtige Aktivitäten in den Straßen von New York City überwachte.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E12 - French Foreign Legion
programme.desc: Ningún otro país aparte de Francia cuenta con una fuerza militar de élite que invita a extranjeros a servir en sus filas. Con la reputación de ser un refugio seguro para individuos con pasados cuestionables, la Legión Extranjera Francesa es un verdadero ejército mercenario que se ha ganado un gran respeto dentro de la comunidad mundial de operaciones especiales. Este episodio de CQB examina una incursión de la Legión Extranjera en un pequeño aeropuerto de Irak durante la Guerra del Golfo de 1990, explorando la naturaleza de la Legión, en qué se diferencia de otras fuerzas especiales y cómo se prepara para una amplia variedad de escenarios de combate cuerpo a cuerpo en situaciones de conflicto en todo el mundo.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E07 - Martian Attractions
programme.desc: This is the latest in Martian exploration, not just from orbit but also from rovers on the ground. New sources of water and planetary dust storms are a few of the stories unfolding on the Red Planet.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E08 - Cubes
programme.desc: Los cubesats son satélites en miniatura que se han utilizado exclusivamente en órbita terrestre baja durante 15 años. Ahora, estos pequeños satélites están ganando popularidad y se utilizan también para misiones interplanetarias. Incluso se han enviado a Marte con la misión Insight, con la esperanza de comprender mejor el planeta rojo, nuestro sistema solar y más allá.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E13 - Hunt and Capture Saddam Hussein
programme.desc: Hace diez años, miles de efectivos de las fuerzas estadounidenses y de la Coalición, desde soldados de élite hasta reservistas, se encontraron en medio de dos conflictos que requerían un enfoque de la guerra totalmente distinto al que habían experimentado hasta entonces. Desde unidades de fuerzas especiales asegurando puntos vitales de interés estratégico y capturando a individuos clave en Afganistán. Este episodio de CQB analiza de cerca cómo se integraron las operaciones especiales en las unidades regulares y cómo lucharon en muchas situaciones de combate cuerpo a cuerpo con una combinación de inteligencia, armamento de alta tecnología y tecnologías de vigilancia para encontrar y capturar a Sadam Husein.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E01 - Riggins Gold
programme.desc: Hoy en Fiebre del Oro, Tom y su hija Kia se encuentran en el caudaloso río Salmón, buscando pepitas de oro bajo el agua. kwadventure
